stop_rule: do not spend campaign time on focal RAD depth

primary_objective: nationwide tree breadth plus initial C_sieboldii population sampling
tree_rule: collect route-efficient tree taxa before extra focal populations
stop_rule: defer C_sieboldii population 3-4 until Level-2 value is confirmed

primary_objective: nationwide western tree breadth plus initial P02 population sampling
focal_topup: C_dipsacolepis 2 populations x15; C_lineare 2 populations x15
tree_rule: collect C_lineare earlier because flowering window is shorter
stop_rule: do not collect third focal populations before missing tree taxa

primary_objective: M01 discovery plus southern-island tree breadth
focal_topup: C_brevicaule Okinawa+Amami and C_irumtiense Miyako+Ishigaki each 15 per population
tree_rule: collect all other admitted southern Cirsium tree representatives encountered
stop_rule: do not add extra M01 islands before E1-E2 promotion

primary_objective: complete summer/high-alpine nationwide taxa and missing second representatives
tree_rule: zero avoidable alpine taxon gaps by end of block
stop_rule: permits and conservation override numeric completion

primary_objective: complete two-per-species tree then enrichment and focal RAD completion
focal_topup: C_sieboldii +2 pops; C_dipsacolepis +1; C_lineare +1 only if justified
tree_rule: tree gaps first then RAD completion then enrichment
stop_rule: missing Level-1 species always outranks extra RAD depth
